papers.title: OmniAct: One Policy, One Million Embodiments
papers.translated_title: OmniAct：一个策略，百万化身
papers.author: Xiang Fan
papers.summary: A single policy that controls diverse robots must not only transfer task knowledge across embodiments, but also adapt its behavior to each robot's capabilities. Existing approaches facilitate transfer through shared action representations, but these representations do not necessarily capture how differences in robot morphology should shape manipulation strategies. We introduce OmniAct, a cross-embodiment manipulation policy that conditions directly on each robot's kinematics in a specific scene to produce embodiment-specific behavior. This kinematic graph represents the robot's joint positions, motion axes, and connectivity to its visual observation, allowing the policy to account for how its embodiment related to objects and surfaces in the scene. A flow-matching policy predicts relative joint motions for each node, enabling control across robots with different degrees of freedom and kinematic configurations. To learn how physical structure shapes behavior at scale, we procedurally design and filter one million physically feasible robot embodiments; next, we develop algorithms to generate robot trajectories in simulation for all embodiments; finally, we train across diverse simulated manipulation tasks. On 2,000 embodiment-scene-held-out evaluation episodes, OmniAct achieves 63.0% success, compared to 17.8% for pi 0.5 and 57.9% for the strongest baseline; on the task families GPT-6 Astra was evaluated on, it achieves 64.7% against GPT-6 Astra's 41.1%. On a previously unseen real-world robot, it achieves nearly twice the success rate of the next best method, MolmoAct2. Beyond task success, we observe that OmniAct learns distinct manipulation strategies that exploit the capabilities and accommodate the limitations of different morphologies. Project: https://omniact.github.io/
papers.translated_summary: 控制多种机器人的单一策略不仅需要在不同具身形态之间迁移任务知识，还必须使其行为适应每个机器人的能力。现有方法通过共享动作表示来促进迁移，但这些表示未必能捕捉机器人形态差异应如何塑造操作策略。我们提出 OmniAct，一种跨具身操作策略，它直接以特定场景中每个机器人的运动学为条件，以产生具身特定的行为。该运动学图表示机器人的关节位置、运动轴及其与视觉观测的连通关系，使策略能够考虑其具身形态如何与场景中的物体和表面相关联。流匹配策略为每个节点预测相对关节运动，从而实现对具有不同自由度和运动学配置的机器人的控制。为了大规模学习物理结构如何塑造行为，我们通过程序化方式设计并筛选了一百万个物理可行的机器人具身形态；接着，我们开发算法为所有具身形态在仿真中生成机器人轨迹；最后，我们在多样化的仿真操作任务上进行训练。在 2,000 个具身-场景留出评估回合中，OmniAct 达到 63.0% 的成功率，而 pi 0.5 为 17.8%，最强基线为 57.9%；在 GPT-6 Astra 所评估的任务族上，它达到 64.7%，而 GPT-6 Astra 为 41.1%。在一个此前未见过的真实世界机器人上，它的成功率几乎是次优方法 MolmoAct2 的两倍。除任务成功率外，我们观察到 OmniAct 学到了不同的操作策略，能够利用不同形态的能力并适应其局限。项目：https://omniact.github.io/

papers.title: PointX: Multi-View Consistent Intrinsics by Querying Surface Points
papers.translated_title: PointX：通过查询表面点实现多视角一致的本征分解
papers.author: Miguel Farinha
papers.summary: The appearance of a scene is determined by the albedo, roughness, metallicity and normal of every point on its surface, and by the light that reaches it, its irradiance. Recovering these intrinsics from images is ambiguous, and methods that predict them per pixel give the same surface point a different decomposition in every view. We introduce PointX, a simple feed-forward model that predicts intrinsics per 3D surface point instead. A multi-view transformer encodes a set of unposed images, and for any queried surface point, PointX pools the point's tokens across the views in which it appears and decodes the point's intrinsics once. Each point of a 3D reconstruction of the scene, such as a point cloud or a mesh, thus receives a single prediction, which is exactly consistent across views by construction and enables view-consistent relighting and editing. The same model also predicts per-view maps, from one image or many, by querying the point seen at every pixel. These maps agree across views up to the precision of the estimated geometry and correspondences. PointX is significantly more consistent than existing methods, while remaining competitive in accuracy from a single image and improving as views are added. Project page: https://pointx-paper.github.io/
papers.translated_summary: 一个场景的外观由其上每一点的反照率、粗糙度、金属度和法线，以及到达该点的光照（即其辐照度）所决定。从图像中恢复这些本征属性存在歧义，而逐像素预测的方法会使同一表面点在每个视图中得到不同的分解结果。我们提出 PointX，一个简单的前馈模型，改为针对每个三维表面点预测本征属性。一个多视图 Transformer 对一组未标定姿态的图像进行编码，对于任意查询的表面点，PointX 汇集该点在出现于其中的各视图中的 token，并一次性解码该点的本征属性。因此，场景三维重建（如点云或网格）的每个点都获得单一预测，该预测在构造上跨视图完全一致，并支持视图一致的重光照与编辑。同一模型还可通过查询每个像素处所见的点，从单张或多张图像预测逐视图的映射图。这些映射图在估计几何与对应关系的精度范围内跨视图一致。PointX 比现有方法显著更一致，同时在单图像精度上保持竞争力，并随视图增加而提升。项目页面：https://pointx-paper.github.io/

papers.title: DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning
papers.translated_title: DiaCap：联合学习谁在何时说话以用于视听对话字幕生成
papers.author: Binfei Ji
papers.summary: We present DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning, which produces the transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of the speaker for every utterance in a video. Considering that utterance timing and audiovisual diarization are tightly coupled, DiaCap unifies the tasks in a single model, trained in two complementary stages. First, we train DiaCap on 225K curated clips, using synthetic captions that densely label every utterance in detail. Second, we further refine the model via reinforcement learning on 2.9K human-corrected clips, using fine-grained feedback that directly evaluates utterance timing, speaker grouping, and speaker binding. On DiaDemBench, which we extend with utterance-level timestamps and subtitle redaction, both DiaCap with off-the-shelf transcripts and its end-to-end variant DiaCap-E2E achieve strong results. Specifically, DiaCap performs on par with Gemini 4 Argon in audiovisual diarization while clearly outperforming it in timestamp accuracy (76.59 vs. 42.76 TIME). It also maintains strong diarization on multilingual and minute-long videos, and transfers to audiovisual question answering.
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出DiaCap，一种用于综合对话字幕生成的音视频大语言模型，可为视频中的每句话生成转写文本、时间戳以及说话人的视觉描述。考虑到话语时间与音视频说话人分离紧密耦合，DiaCap将这两项任务统一在单一模型中，并分两个互补阶段进行训练。首先，我们在22.5万条精选片段上训练DiaCap，使用对每句话进行详细密集标注的合成字幕。其次，我们通过强化学习在2900条人工校正片段上进一步优化模型，使用细粒度反馈直接评估话语时间、说话人分组和说话人绑定。在我们扩展了话语级时间戳和字幕遮蔽的DiaDemBench上，使用现成转写文本的DiaCap及其端到端变体DiaCap-E2E均取得强劲结果。具体而言，DiaCap在音视频说话人分离上与Gemini 4 Argon表现相当，同时在时间戳准确性上明显优于后者（76.59对42.76 TIME）。它还在多语言和分钟级长视频上保持强劲的说话人分离性能，并可迁移至音视频问答任务。

papers.title: BioLoom: Scaling Biomedical Vision-Language Models by Learning from the Structure of Scientific Articles
papers.translated_title: BioLoom：通过从科学文章的结构中学习来扩展生物医学视觉-语言模型
papers.author: Yuwei Yang
papers.summary: The development of biomedical vision-language models (VLMs) with contrastive image-text pretraining has been driven by scaling to increasingly large and diverse image-text datasets. Beyond scaling, further progress can come from learning richer representations from existing data. We hypothesize that the structure of scientific literature itself provides an additional source of supervision: figures, panels, captions, and accompanying article text encode rich relationships across modalities. Yet, treating these as independent image-text pairs overlooks their relationships. To address this limitation, we incorporate these structural relationships into contrastive image-text supervision. We preserve exact image-text matches while introducing weaker positive supervision for related pairs, such as a panel and the caption of a sibling panel. We upweight cross-article negatives of the same content type to encourage finer discrimination. We also enrich panel descriptions using visual content, original figure captions, and mentioning paragraphs. Pairing panels with these descriptions and whole figures with their original captions yields Loom52M, a dataset of 52.4 million image-text pairs spanning scientific charts and biomedical images. Using Loom52M, BioLoom (DFN-2B) achieves 56.82% domain-balanced mean accuracy across 67 zero-shot classification tasks from 43 datasets in 10 domains, compared with 48.77% for MedPMC-CLIP. On BioLoomBench with concise captions and BioMedFlickr, it achieves bidirectional mean Recall@1 of 63.20% and 10.59%, versus 46.37% and 7.55% for the respective strongest evaluated baselines, BiomedCLIP and MedPMC-CLIP. Code, datasets, benchmarks, and models are available at https://bioloom-clip.github.io/.
papers.translated_summary: 具有对比图文预训练的的生物医学视觉语言模型（VLMs）的发展，一直由向规模日益庞大且多样化的图文数据集扩展所驱动。除扩展之外，进一步进展还可来自从现有数据中学习更丰富的表征。我们假设科学文献本身的结构提供了额外的监督来源：图、子图、图注以及伴随的正文文本编码了跨模态的丰富关系。然而，将这些视为独立的图文对忽视了它们之间的关系。为解决这一局限，我们将这些结构关系纳入对比图文监督。我们在保留精确图文匹配的同时，为相关对（例如子图与同级子图的图注）引入较弱的正监督。我们提高同内容类型的跨文章负样本的权重，以鼓励更精细的区分。我们还利用视觉内容、原始图注和提及段落来丰富子图描述。将子图与这些描述配对、将整图与原始图注配对，产生了 Loom52M，一个包含 5240 万图文对、涵盖科学图表和生物医学图像的数据集。使用 Loom52M，BioLoom（DFN-2B）在来自 10 个领域 43 个数据集的 67 个零样本分类任务上取得 56.82% 的领域平衡平均准确率，而 MedPMC-CLIP 为 48.77%。在具有简洁图注的 BioLoomBench 和 BioMedFlickr 上，它取得 63.20% 和 10.59% 的双向平均 Recall@1，而各自评估的最强基线 BiomedCLIP 和 MedPMC-CLIP 分别为 46.37% 和 7.55%。代码、数据集、基准和模型可在 https://bioloom-clip.github.io/ 获取。

papers.title: Parametric neural-network wavefunctions across a bosonic phase transition
papers.translated_title: 玻色相变中的参数化神经网络波函数
papers.author: Daniil S. Antonenko
papers.summary: We propose Boseformer, a universal attention-based neural-network architecture for representing the wavefunctions of particles with bosonic quantum statistics, including superfluid and crystal phases. The model is trained to generate the wavefunction as a function of a Hamiltonian parameter across the quantum phase transition between these phases. Once trained with variational Monte Carlo optimization, it can serve as a foundation model describing the phase transition without the need to retrain it for individual parameter values. We demonstrate our method on a system of two-dimensional bosons with $1/r^3$ repulsive interaction.
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出Boseformer，一种通用的基于注意力的神经网络架构，用于表示具有玻色量子统计的粒子波函数，包括超流相和晶体相。该模型被训练为在跨越这些相之间的量子相变时，将波函数生成为哈密顿量参数的函数。一旦通过变分蒙特卡洛优化训练完成，它就可以作为一个基础模型来描述相变，而无需针对单个参数值重新训练。我们在一个具有1/r^3排斥相互作用的二维玻色子系统上演示了我们的方法。

papers.title: CoT-Proxy: Cross-Format Transfer for Distilling Long-Horizon Policies
papers.translated_title: CoT-Proxy：用于蒸馏长时程策略的跨格式迁移
papers.author: Dawid J. Kopiczko
papers.summary: Reasoning models become long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning or, more cheaply, through fine-tuning on a stronger teacher's trajectories, which contain the teacher's chain-of-thought as well as its actions. The standard fine-tuning approach imitates both, yet the strongest teachers are closed models whose chain-of-thought is hidden behind an API. We show that the chain-of-thought can be left out altogether and that the long-horizon policy can be distilled from the teacher's actions alone. The student is trained on these trajectories with its reasoning block left empty, while a KL loss on a replay buffer of its own generations limits drift from its initial model. Surprisingly, the policy learned from these trajectories with an empty reasoning block carries over to inference with thinking enabled, where the student reasons in its own style while acting like the teacher, an effect we call cross-format transfer. Distilling the actions of Qwen3.6-27B raises the task success of Qwen3-4B on AppWorld from 7% to 18% and that of Qwen3-32B from 12% to 25%. We further introduce CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher's reasoning placed after the empty reasoning block, which raise Qwen3-4B further, to 35%. Since neither actions nor CoT-proxies need the hidden chain-of-thought, the recipe applies unchanged to closed teachers. Distilling GPT-5.6 Luna from its visible outputs and the reasoning summaries its API returns raises Qwen3-4B from 7% to 48% on AppWorld and from 3% to 28% on SWE-bench Verified.
papers.translated_summary: 推理模型通过强化学习，或更廉价地，通过在更强教师的轨迹上进行微调，成为长时程智能体，这些轨迹包含教师的思维链及其动作。标准的微调方法会同时模仿两者，然而最强的教师是闭源模型，其思维链隐藏在 API 之后。我们表明，思维链可以完全省略，长时程策略可以仅从教师的动作中蒸馏。学生在这些轨迹上训练，其推理块留空，同时对其自身生成的重放缓冲区施加 KL 损失，以限制其偏离初始模型。令人惊讶的是，从这些轨迹中学到的、推理块为空的策略可以迁移到启用思考的推理中，此时学生以自己的风格推理，同时像教师一样行动，我们将这一效应称为跨格式迁移。蒸馏 Qwen3.6-27B 的动作将 Qwen3-4B 在 AppWorld 上的任务成功率从 7% 提升到 18%，将 Qwen3-32B 的成功率从 12% 提升到 25%。我们进一步引入 CoT 代理，即放置在空推理块之后的教师推理的简短摘要，将 Qwen3-4B 进一步提升到 35%。由于动作和 CoT 代理都不需要隐藏的思维链，该方案原封不动地适用于闭源教师。从 GPT-5.6 Luna 的可见输出及其 API 返回的推理摘要中蒸馏，将 Qwen3-4B 在 AppWorld 上从 7% 提升到 48%，在 SWE-bench Verified 上从 3% 提升到 28%。

papers.title: One Take, Many Cameras: Audio-Grounded Shot Synthesis for Dialogue Re-Cinematography
papers.translated_title: 一镜到底，多机位：面向对话重摄影的音频驱动镜头合成
papers.author: Anthony Chen
papers.summary: Creating a dialogue scene typically requires cutting between multiple views (e.g., close-ups, medium shots, and over-the-shoulder shots) of the actors. Yet capturing such coverage is costly and in many settings unavailable. We study dialogue re-cinematography: synthesizing additional shots from a single wide-angle dialogue video. Existing video generators can synthesize new shots, but rely on visual cues alone, so when the source video barely shows the lips, the generated lip motion fails to match the speech. Our key observation is that the speech audio is view-invariant: it constrains lip motion in any target view. Building on this insight, we adapt a pretrained audio-visual diffusion model to generate the new shot from a target frame that specifies the view, a source video that contains the performance, and the speech audio that drives lip motion. In multi-person scenes, however, pretrained audio-visual models drive every visible face with the same speech, causing speech leakage, where silent listeners mouth the speaker's words. We therefore introduce speaker-aware audio gating, a training-free module that lets the audio drive only the faces that speak in the target shot. On a cinematic paired-view benchmark spanning diverse viewpoints and framings, our method lowers perceptual error by 59%, landmark error by 56%, and speech leakage by 97% relative to the strongest baseline, Wan 3.0. Our method also remains robust on in-the-wild scenes, highlighting its potential for film post-production.
papers.translated_summary: 创建对话场景通常需要在演员的多个视角之间切换（例如特写、中景和过肩镜头）。然而，拍摄这样的多视角素材成本高昂，在许多场景下甚至无法实现。我们研究对话重摄影：从单个广角对话视频中合成额外的镜头。现有的视频生成器可以合成新镜头，但仅依赖视觉线索，因此当源视频几乎无法显示嘴唇时，生成的唇部运动无法与语音匹配。我们的关键观察是，语音音频具有视角不变性：它在任何目标视角中都约束唇部运动。基于这一洞见，我们调整了一个预训练的音频-视觉扩散模型，从指定视角的目标帧、包含表演的源视频以及驱动唇部运动的语音音频来生成新镜头。然而，在多人物场景中，预训练的音频-视觉模型会用同一语音驱动每一张可见面孔，导致语音泄漏，即沉默的听者会模仿说话者的口型。因此，我们引入了说话人感知音频门控，这是一个无需训练的模块，使音频仅驱动目标镜头中说话的面孔。在涵盖多样视角和构图的电影配对视角基准上，我们的方法相对于最强基线Wan 3.0，将感知误差降低了59%，关键点误差降低了56%，语音泄漏降低了97%。我们的方法在野外场景中也保持稳健，凸显了其在电影后期制作中的潜力。

papers.title: Lost on Campus: Evaluating Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in the Wild
papers.translated_title: 校园迷途：在真实环境中评估视觉语言模型的具身空间推理能力
papers.author: Zehan Zheng
papers.summary: Embodied Spatial Reasoning (ESR) is central to deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in real-world embodied tasks, yet remains inadequately evaluated. Existing benchmarks primarily assess spatial reasoning in static images or synthetic indoor environments, where semantic shortcuts often suffice, making it difficult to faithfully evaluate spatial reasoning capabilities in the wild. In light of this, we present Lost on Campus, a benchmark for evaluating ESR in large-scale real-world outdoor 3D environments reconstructed by 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our benchmark introduces a unified reasoning-action evaluation framework that seamlessly integrates diagnostic QA for isolated reasoning with closed-loop interactive navigation for active reasoning under multimodal instructions. To enable fine-grained diagnosis, we evaluate six capability aspects of ESR: action grounding, spatial foresight, metric awareness, goal-directed planning, ego-allocentric localization, and spatio-temporal consistency. Extensive experiments reveal that: (i) Compared to indoor settings, real-world outdoor environments impose substantially higher demands on spatial reasoning, where existing models exhibit poor performance; (ii) VLMs still struggle with fine-grained visual alignment, with failures in spatial foresight and ego-allocentric localization emerging as primary bottlenecks; (iii) Improving multimodal interaction capabilities and long-term spatial reasoning is crucial for advancing embodied intelligence. These findings highlight that faithful evaluation of ESR demands benchmarks tightly coupling perception, reasoning and action within realistic and continuous environments.
papers.translated_summary: 具身空间推理（Embodied Spatial Reasoning, ESR）是将视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）部署于真实世界具身任务的核心能力，然而其评估仍不充分。现有基准主要在静态图像或合成室内环境中评估空间推理，其中语义捷径往往足以应对，因而难以忠实评估真实环境中的空间推理能力。鉴于此，我们提出 Lost on Campus，一个用于评估大规模真实户外三维环境中具身空间推理的基准，该环境通过三维高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）重建。我们的基准引入统一的推理-行动评估框架，将用于孤立推理的诊断性问答与用于多模态指令下主动推理的闭环交互式导航无缝集成。为实现细粒度诊断，我们评估具身空间推理的六个能力方面：动作 grounding、空间前瞻、度量感知、目标导向规划、自我- allocentric 定位以及时空一致性。大量实验揭示：（i）与室内环境相比，真实户外环境对空间推理提出显著更高的要求，现有模型表现不佳；（ii）视觉语言模型仍在细粒度视觉对齐方面存在困难，空间前瞻与自我- allocentric 定位的失败成为主要瓶颈；（iii）提升多模态交互能力与长期空间推理对于推进具身智能至关重要。这些发现表明，忠实地评估具身空间推理需要将感知、推理与行动紧密耦合于真实且连续环境中的基准。

papers.title: ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification
papers.translated_title: ROAM-Bench：通过证据验证评估具身主动空间智能
papers.author: Xingjian Ran
papers.summary: Embodied spatial intelligence requires agents to gather information through exploration and interaction, then use it to reason and act. Existing benchmarks insufficiently distinguish correct outcomes from completion of these task requirements. We introduce ROAM-Bench to evaluate these abilities under robot motion and collision constraints. Independent checks use simulation state and episode records to assess outcomes and task requirements, with stronger checks of geometry, coverage, or placement. It comprises 250 manually validated tasks across 11 types in five groups and 27 indoor environments, covering object and room search, counting, geometric judgments, direction reasoning, and relocation. Human evaluators achieve 84% strict task success on 100 sampled tasks, with every correct outcome satisfying the required checks. Across seven frontier vision-language models, we identify two complementary failure modes: correct outcomes with unmet task requirements, and incorrect outcomes despite passing stronger checks. Oracle-input diagnostics show that more complete target observations and calibrated feedback improve final spatial judgments.
papers.translated_summary: 具身空间智能要求智能体通过探索与交互收集信息，再利用这些信息进行推理和行动。现有基准不足以区分正确结果与任务要求的完成情况。我们提出ROAM-Bench，用于在机器人运动与碰撞约束下评估这些能力。独立检查利用仿真状态和回合记录来评估结果与任务要求，并对几何、覆盖或放置进行更严格的检查。它包含250个经人工验证的任务，涵盖五大组11种类型和27个室内环境，涉及物体与房间搜索、计数、几何判断、方向推理和重定位。人类评估者在100个抽样任务上达到84%的严格任务成功率，且每个正确结果均满足所要求的检查。在七个前沿视觉语言模型中，我们识别出两种互补的失败模式：结果正确但任务要求未满足，以及尽管通过了更严格的检查但结果错误。Oracle输入诊断表明，更完整的目标观测和校准反馈可改善最终空间判断。

papers.title: iWAM: Efficient Action Prediction from World Models without Explicit Future Prediction
papers.translated_title: iWAM：无需显式未来预测即可从世界模型中进行高效动作预测
papers.author: Vansh Kapoor
papers.summary: World-action models (WAMs) build policies on pretrained video-generation models, on the premise that predicting how a scene evolves helps determine how to act. However, generating future scenes is expensive for real-time control. This motivates efficient proxies for future imagination, but how to train such proxies without sacrificing action-prediction quality remains unclear. An effective proxy need not generate a high-resolution frame; it only needs to provide enough information to distinguish between possible futures. This leads to the design principle behind iWAM: rather than denoising an entire future frame, can we condition the action policy on intermediate features from a single video-model evaluation? We show that the answer is yes. Exploiting the reversible dynamics of flow-matching models, we invert each training future into the corresponding latent noise vector. However, a single velocity evaluation at this latent does not necessarily yield informative features for action prediction. We therefore learn a bidirectional flow map that amortizes future-generation computation, enabling a single model evaluation to provide effective conditioning features. At inference, we sample a latent noise vector from the prior and condition the policy using just one video-backbone forward pass. Across simulated benchmarks and real robots, iWAM recovers the generalization benefits of WAMs while substantially reducing its inference cost.
papers.translated_summary: 世界动作模型（WAMs）在预训练视频生成模型上构建策略，其前提是预测场景如何演化有助于确定如何行动。然而，生成未来场景对于实时控制而言代价高昂。这促使人们寻求未来想象的高效代理，但如何在不牺牲动作预测质量的前提下训练此类代理仍不明确。有效的代理无需生成高分辨率帧；它只需提供足够的信息以区分可能的未来。这引出了iWAM背后的设计原则：与其对整幅未来帧进行去噪，我们能否以单次视频模型评估的中间特征为动作策略提供条件？我们证明答案是肯定的。利用流匹配模型的可逆动力学，我们将每个训练未来反演为对应的潜在噪声向量。然而，在该潜在变量上进行单次速度评估未必能产生对动作预测有信息量的特征。因此，我们学习一个双向流映射，以摊销未来生成的计算量，使单次模型评估即可提供有效的条件特征。在推理时，我们从先验中采样一个潜在噪声向量，并仅通过一次视频骨干网络前向传播为策略提供条件。在模拟基准和真实机器人上，iWAM恢复了WAMs的泛化优势，同时大幅降低了其推理成本。

papers.title: Genome architecture and duplication-associated functional diversification in the carnivorous plant Sarracenia purpurea
papers.translated_title: 食虫植物紫瓶子草的基因组结构及复制相关的功能多样化
papers.author: Albert, V. A.
papers.summary: The repeated evolution of complex traits raises the question of how genomes generate ecological novelty while preserving developmental organization. We present a chromosome-scale genome assembly and annotation for the carnivorous purple pitcher plant, Sarracenia purpurea, and investigate how two contrasting modes of gene duplication have shaped its genome and functional repertoire: ancient polyploidy, which leaves duplicated genes in conserved chromosomal regions (syntenic duplicates), and local tandem duplication, which generates neighboring gene copies. We compare these duplication classes across nine angiosperms. The genome shows a mosaic of conserved and fractionated duplicated regions reflecting differential retention and loss of genes following ancient polyploidy and later restructuring. Comparison with noncarnivorous Actinidia (kiwifruit) identifies 18 syntenic and nine tandem Gene Ontology (GO) Biological Process term-duplication-class combinations enriched in Sarracenia but not significantly enriched in Actinidia. Syntenic enrichments include meristem maintenance, organ-boundary specification, cuticle development, and hormonal regulation; tandem enrichments include defense responses, oxidative stress, jasmonic-acid biosynthesis, leaf senescence, and oligopeptide transport. Across the carnivorous genera Sarracenia, Nepenthes, Utricularia, and Pinguicula, we identify 19 syntenic and two tandem-associated biological processes showing significant enrichment in all four lineages, revealing striking functional commonalities across multiple evolutionary origins of carnivory despite their divergent trap morphologies and ecological strategies. Among Sarracenia genes differentially expressed in at least one comparison of flower, pitcher-leaf, and root tissues, tandem-class genes exhibit larger maximum absolute expression differences and greater GO richness and effective breadth at matched numbers of annotated homologs. These results highlight the complementary evolutionary contributions of ancient genome duplication and local gene-family expansion to the developmental and ecological diversification of carnivorous plants.
papers.translated_summary: 复杂性状的反复演化提出了一个问题：基因组如何在保持发育组织性的同时产生生态新颖性。我们提出了食肉性紫瓶子草Sarracenia purpurea的染色体尺度基因组组装与注释，并研究了两种对比鲜明的基因复制模式如何塑造了其基因组和功能库：古老的多倍化，其将重复基因保留在保守的染色体区域（共线性重复）；以及局部串联重复，其产生邻近的基因拷贝。我们在九种被子植物中比较了这些复制类别。该基因组显示出保守和片段化重复区域的镶嵌格局，反映了古老多倍化及随后重构后基因的差异保留与丢失。与非食肉性猕猴桃属Actinidia（猕猴桃）的比较鉴定出18个共线性和9个串联的基因本体（GO）生物过程术语-复制类别组合在Sarracenia中富集但在Actinidia中未显著富集。共线性富集包括分生组织维持、器官边界特化、角质层发育和激素调控；串联富集包括防御反应、氧化应激、茉莉酸生物合成、叶片衰老和寡肽转运。在食肉属Sarracenia、Nepenthes、Utricularia和Pinguicula中，我们鉴定出19个共线性和两个串联相关的生物过程在所有四个谱系中均显示显著富集，揭示了尽管捕虫器形态和生态策略各异，但食肉性多次独立起源之间惊人的功能共性。在花、瓶状叶和根组织至少一次比较中差异表达的Sarracenia基因中，串联类基因在匹配的注释同源基因数量下表现出更大的最大绝对表达差异以及更高的GO丰富度和有效广度。这些结果突出了古老基因组复制和局部基因家族扩张对食肉植物发育和生态多样化的互补性演化贡献。

papers.title: FoXSight: Facilitating Computational Hit Identification in Crystallographic Fragment Screening Experiments
papers.translated_title: FoXSight：促进晶体学片段筛选实验中的计算命中识别
papers.author: Schulze, T.
papers.summary: X-ray crystallographic fragment screening reveals how small molecules bind to proteins, providing important starting points for drug design. Identifying these weak binding events remains difficult when electron density signals are noisy, partially occupied or obscured by solvent, and campaigns may comprise thousands of datasets. Here, we present FoXSight, a computational method for hit identification in crystallographic compound screening. FoXSight applies Difference-of-Gaussian (DoG) filtering to multi-reference subtraction maps to detect recurring, target-specific density features associated with bound ligands. Its output maps remain visually interpretable and support subsequent ligand modeling. We evaluated FoXSight on in-house and public datasets spanning seven protein targets, comparing its maps with PanDDA where suitable comparison data were available. FoXSight was successfully used as the primary hit identification tool in a challenging crystallographic fragment screening campaign for human Cathepsin L, where the output of established methods was impractical to inspect systematically.
papers.translated_summary: X射线晶体学片段筛选揭示了小分子如何与蛋白质结合，为药物设计提供了重要的起点。当电子密度信号存在噪声、部分占据或被溶剂遮蔽时，以及筛选活动可能包含数千个数据集时，识别这些弱结合事件仍然困难。在此，我们提出FoXSight，一种用于晶体学化合物筛选中命中识别的计算方法。FoXSight将高斯差分（DoG）滤波应用于多参考减法图，以检测与结合配体相关的重复出现、靶标特异性的密度特征。其输出图保持视觉可解释性，并支持后续的配体建模。我们在涵盖七个蛋白质靶标的内部和公共数据集上评估了FoXSight，并在有合适比较数据的情况下将其图与PanDDA进行比较。FoXSight成功用作人类组织蛋白酶L一项具有挑战性的晶体学片段筛选活动的主要命中识别工具，在该活动中，现有方法的输出无法进行系统性的实际检查。

papers.title: Structural basis for alpha-actinin inhibition of cofilin binding to actin filaments
papers.translated_title: α-辅肌动蛋白抑制丝切蛋白与肌动蛋白丝结合的結構基础
papers.author: Ngo, K. X.
papers.summary: Actin is a conserved cytoskeletal protein essential for morphogenesis, motility, and division. Its versatility arises from filament assembly and regulation by actin binding proteins. Among these, alpha-actinin organizes filaments into bipolar or unipolar networks, whereas cofilin binds preferentially to ADP-actin regions and forms clusters to shorten the half helical pitch (HHP). Here, we investigated the molecular mechanism of how alpha-actinin alters filament and protomer conformations and influences cofilin binding. Using high-speed atomic force microscopy, all-atom molecular dynamics simulations, and principal component analysis, we show that alpha-actinin crosslinking stabilizes actin filaments in the canonical helical state, thereby preventing the cofilin-induced helical shortening required for cooperative filament decoration. Stabilization occurs without significant changes in protomer twist and rise and subdomain geometry and maintains a flattened protomer conformation that restricts twisting needed for cofilin binding. Furthermore, myosin II (S1) and cofilin preferentially bind to normal and shortened half-helical structures, respectively. In contrast, the isolated alpha-actinin-1 actin binding domain mutant (ABD-E235K) and wild-type (ABD-WT) induce local transitions from the canonical double-helical filament to the single-helical protofilament, parallel-helical protofilament state (PPS), and nano-ring structures, while only weakly affecting cofilin binding and cluster formation on PPS. Notably, cofilin can bind and form clusters along single protofilaments without inducing helical-pitch shortening. Together, these findings reveal a mechanistically distinct function of full-length alpha-actinin and its isolated ABD and support a stepwise mechanism in which cofilin cooperative binding to canonical double-helical actin filaments requires initial binding to actin regions with shortened HHP, followed by protomer twisting and further helical shortening.
papers.translated_summary: 肌动蛋白是一种保守的细胞骨架蛋白，对形态发生、运动和分裂至关重要。其多功能性源于丝状组装以及肌动蛋白结合蛋白的调控。其中，α-辅肌动蛋白将丝状体组织成双极性或单极性网络，而丝切蛋白优先结合ADP-肌动蛋白区域并形成簇以缩短半螺旋螺距（HHP）。在此，我们研究了α-辅肌动蛋白如何改变丝状体和原体构象并影响丝切蛋白结合的分子机制。利用高速原子力显微镜、全原子分子动力学模拟和主成分分析，我们表明α-辅肌动蛋白交联将肌动蛋白丝稳定在经典螺旋状态，从而阻止丝切蛋白诱导的螺旋缩短，而后者是协同丝状体装饰所必需的。稳定化发生时不伴随原体扭转和升距及亚结构域几何形状的显著变化，并维持一种扁平的原体构象，该构象限制了丝切蛋白结合所需的扭转。此外，肌球蛋白II（S1）和丝切蛋白分别优先结合正常和缩短的半螺旋结构。相比之下，分离的α-辅肌动蛋白-1肌动蛋白结合结构域突变体（ABD-E235K）和野生型（ABD-WT）诱导从经典双螺旋丝状体向单螺旋原丝、平行螺旋原丝状态（PPS）和纳米环结构的局部转变，同时对丝切蛋白结合及PPS上的簇形成影响微弱。值得注意的是，丝切蛋白可以沿单一原丝结合并形成簇，而不诱导螺旋螺距缩短。总之，这些发现揭示了全长α-辅肌动蛋白及其分离ABD的一种机制上独特的功能，并支持一种逐步机制，即丝切蛋白与经典双螺旋肌动蛋白丝的协同结合需要首先结合到具有缩短HHP的肌动蛋白区域，随后发生原体扭转和进一步的螺旋缩短。

papers.title: Spatial geometry of the Hypoxic niche predicts Radiotherapy failure in Colorectal Cancer: A Spatially Explicit Agent-Based Model
papers.translated_title: 缺氧微空间几何预测结直肠癌放疗失败：一个空间显式的基于主体的模型
papers.author: Panchagnula, S. D. K.
papers.summary: Radiotherapy failure in locally advanced colorectal cancer is mechanistically linked to tumour microenvironmental heterogeneity, yet the spatial determinants of immune clearance following fractionated irradiation remain poorly understood. Here we present a spatially explicit hybrid agent-based model of colorectal cancer response to short-course radiotherapy in which cellular fate - proliferation, dormancy, or necrosis - is governed by local oxygen tension and ATP availability computed via Michaelis - Menten kinetics. Immune killing probability and proliferation rate are implemented as continuous functions of local oxygen, replacing hard thresholds with mechanistically grounded gradients. Simulations of the standard 5 x 5 Gy short-course radiotherapy protocol revealed a bimodal tumour control distribution consistent with clinical observations of cure-or-escape outcomes. The central finding is that spatial position within the oxygen landscape, rather than surviving cell count alone, predicts immune clearance success: runs in which the tumour was eliminated had surviving cells in well-oxygenated regions near vasculature(meanO2 = 0.967), while escaped tumours retained cells concentrated in the hypoxic core (mean O2 = 0.196; Mann - Whitney p= 2.1 x 10-9). Fractionation schedule analysis across equal total-dose protocols demonstrated that inter-fraction interval critically modulates repopulation dynamics and tumour control probability, with compact schedules outperforming widely-spaced fractionation despite identical cumulative dose. Transcriptomic validation using the Buffa hypoxia signature across 284 Stage II/III CRC patients from TCGA confirmed that significant tumour hypoxia is a clinically prevalent feature of the target disease population. These results suggest that the geometry of the hypoxic niche is a spatial determinant of radiotherapy outcome in colorectal cancer, with implications for treatment scheduling and patient stratification by hypoxia burden.
papers.translated_summary: 局部晚期结直肠癌的放疗失败在机制上与肿瘤微环境异质性相关，但分次照射后免疫清除的空间决定因素仍知之甚少。在此，我们提出一个空间显式的混合智能体模型，用于模拟结直肠癌对短程放疗的反应，其中细胞命运——增殖、休眠或坏死——由局部氧张力和通过Michaelis-Menten动力学计算的ATP可用性决定。免疫杀伤概率和增殖速率被实现为局部氧的连续函数，以机制上合理的梯度取代硬阈值。对标准5×5 Gy短程放疗方案的模拟揭示了与临床观察到的治愈或逃逸结局一致的双峰肿瘤控制分布。核心发现是，氧景观中的空间位置而非仅存活细胞计数，可预测免疫清除的成功：肿瘤被消除的运行中，存活细胞位于血管附近氧合良好的区域（平均O2=0.967），而逃逸的肿瘤则保留集中于缺氧核心的细胞（平均O2=0.196；Mann-Whitney p=2.1×10^-9）。跨等总剂量方案的分次照射时间表分析表明，分次间间隔关键性地调节再增殖动力学和肿瘤控制概率，尽管累积剂量相同，紧凑时间表优于宽间隔分次照射。使用Buffa缺氧特征对来自TCGA的284例II/III期CRC患者进行的转录组验证证实，显著肿瘤缺氧是该目标疾病人群的临床普遍特征。这些结果提示，缺氧龛的几何结构是结直肠癌放疗结局的空间决定因素，对治疗排程和按缺氧负荷进行患者分层具有意义。

papers.title: Structure determination and dual targeting of a plant TACO1 identifies its ancient role as an organelle translation regulator
papers.translated_title: 植物TACO1的结构解析及其双重靶向揭示了其作为细胞器翻译调控因子的古老作用
papers.author: Raval, P. K.
papers.summary: Ribosome stalling caused by polyproline (PPs) motifs is common. Their translation is enhanced by accessory proteins such as YebC in bacteria, whose homolog, TRANSLATIONAL ACTIVATOR OF CYTOCHROME C OXIDASE 1 (TACO1), aids the translation of mitochondria-encoded proteins. The prevalence of PP motifs across plastid-encoded genes and their impact on the translation of photosynthesis-relevant proteins remains unexplored. Equally, a translation-enhancer of PP motifs equivalent to TACO1 for plastid ribosomes has not been reported. Here, we show that plastid genomes encode 24 proteins with a minimum of one PP motif on average, half of which are conserved in their cyanobacterial homologs. We also find that the vast majority of eukaryotes, including plants, encode only a single TACO1 that we demonstrate to be dually targeted to mitochondria and plastids of Marchantia polymorpha. We resolved the MpTACO1 structure at 2.34 [A] by X-ray crystallography and its flexibility by small-angle X-ray scattering. Through modelling, we demonstrate that MpTACO1 can fit into the peptidyl transfer centre of plant chlororibosomes in a similar manner as human TACO1 in the mitoribosome. The identification and structure determination of the first plastid-targeted YebC/TACO1 allows us to sketch a unified model for the function and evolution of this ancient family of ribosomal accessory proteins, underscoring their indispensable role in the translation of bioenergetic membrane proteins reaching back almost 4 billion years.
papers.translated_summary: 多聚脯氨酸（PPs）基序引起的核糖体停滞是常见的现象。其翻译由细菌中的YebC等辅助蛋白增强，其同源蛋白——细胞色素c氧化酶1的翻译激活因子（TACO1）——协助线粒体编码蛋白的翻译。PP基序在质体编码基因中的普遍性及其对光合作用相关蛋白翻译的影响尚未被探索。同样，尚未有报道称存在与TACO1相当的、作用于质体核糖体的PP基序翻译增强因子。在此，我们展示质体基因组平均编码24种至少含有一个PP基序的蛋白质，其中一半在其蓝藻同源蛋白中是保守的。我们还发现，绝大多数真核生物（包括植物）仅编码单一TACO1，我们证明该蛋白在地钱（Marchantia polymorpha）中双重靶向线粒体和质体。我们通过X射线晶体学以2.34 Å的分辨率解析了MpTACO1的结构，并通过小角X射线散射研究了其柔性。通过建模，我们证明MpTACO1能够以类似于人TACO1在线粒体核糖体中的方式嵌入植物叶绿体核糖体的肽基转移中心。首个质体靶向YebC/TACO1的鉴定和结构解析使我们能够勾勒出这一古老核糖体辅助蛋白家族的功能和进化的统一模型，突显了它们在近40亿年来生物能量膜蛋白翻译中不可或缺的作用。

papers.title: Ultrasonic emissions of sunflower and buckwheat carry species identity in their spectrum and drought in their rate
papers.translated_title: 向日葵和荞麦的超声波发射在频谱中携带物种身份，在速率中携带干旱信息
papers.author: Saha, B.
papers.summary: Plants under water deficit produce ultrasonic acoustic emissions that can be recorded in air. Species have been compared mainly by peak frequency. We report, to our knowledge, the first airborne recordings of sunflower (Helianthus annuus) and buckwheat (Fagopyrum esculentum), with gas exchange and chlorophyll fluorescence on the same plants. Across 119 recordings of 30 min each, made on two drought and two watered end plants per species, every drought plant emitted more events over the series than the watered plants. Rates rose 107 fold in sunflower and 5.3 fold in buckwheat, coincided with low stomatal conductance, and later fell in single plants. In sunflower, emission was already raised when maximum Photosystem II quantum yield was similar between treatments. At equal loudness, sunflower events carried a median of 24% of their energy at 40-80 kHz, against 2% in buckwheat, in drought and watered plants alike, although both species peaked near 30 kHz. In a proof of concept on four plants per species, this share identified a held-out plant's species in 96% of draws of five events. Airborne ultrasound thus carries species identity in its spectrum and drought in its event rate, two signals a non-contact sensor could combine.
papers.translated_summary: 水分亏缺下的植物会产生可在空气中记录的超声声发射。物种之间的比较主要依据峰值频率。据我们所知，我们首次报道了向日葵（Helianthus annuus）和荞麦（Fagopyrum esculentum）的空气中录音，并对同一植株进行了气体交换和叶绿素荧光测定。每个物种各有两株干旱处理和两株浇水处理的末端植株，共进行119次、每次30分钟的录音，在整个系列中，每株干旱植株发出的声事件均多于浇水植株。向日葵的声发射速率上升了107倍，荞麦上升了5.3倍，与低气孔导度相吻合，随后在单株中下降。在向日葵中，当两种处理间的最大光系统II量子产率相似时，声发射已经升高。在相同响度下，向日葵声事件在40-80 kHz频段携带的能量中位数为24%，而荞麦为2%，干旱植株和浇水植株均如此，尽管两个物种的峰值频率都在30 kHz附近。在每个物种四株植株的概念验证中，这一份额在五次声事件抽取中有96%能识别出留出植株的物种。因此，空气超声在其频谱中携带物种身份信息，在其事件率中携带干旱信息，这是非接触式传感器可以结合的两个信号。

papers.title: Differential DNA methylation and transcriptome revealed enhanced photosynthetic recovery and ROS modulation to promote cold tolerance in Oryza sativa L. ssp. indica.
papers.translated_title: 差异DNA甲基化与转录组揭示增强的光合恢复和ROS调节促进籼稻耐冷性。
papers.author: Roy, V.
papers.summary: Indica rice, being a tropical crop, is highly sensitive to cold temperatures. Cold stress affects vegetative growth, photosynthetic efficiency and reproductive features. Screening diverse landraces to identify novel alleles associated with cold tolerance can be an approach to develop cold resilient indica rice. We have characterized a boro germplasm, CB1, with an efficient germination rate and growth vigor when treated with chilling temperatures. CB1 seedlings show a higher survival rate compared to IR36 when subjected to prolonged chilling stress. Biochemical analysis indicated efficient ROS modulation, higher chlorophyll content, enhanced photosystem II efficiency and unique stomatal traits, leading to higher relative water content in CB1 plants during stress and recovery. Germplasm-specific DNA methylome and transcriptome uniquely regulate the expression of chlorophyll biosynthesis, photosystem, & light harvesting complex and ROS scavenger genes in CB1 seedlings during stress recovery. Interestingly, high D1 protein turnover in CB1 promotes damage repair of PSII for efficient photosynthesis. Furthermore, key transcription factors for stomatal development and expression of photosynthetic genes were upregulated in CB1 during stress recovery. Notably, higher expression of GLK1 and enrichment of GLK1 targets were observed in CB1 plants during chilling stress and recovery. Taken together, our results indicate that GLK1 and WRKY40 negatively regulates the inhibitory role of ABI5 for efficient photosynthetic recovery to enhance cold tolerance in CB1 rice.
papers.translated_summary: 籼稻作为热带作物，对低温高度敏感。低温胁迫影响营养生长、光合效率和生殖特性。筛选丰富的农家品种以鉴定与耐冷性相关的新等位基因，可作为培育耐冷籼稻的一种途径。我们鉴定了一个boro种质CB1，其在低温处理下具有高效的萌发率和生长活力。与IR36相比，CB1幼苗在长时间低温胁迫下表现出更高的存活率。生化分析表明，CB1植株在胁迫和恢复期间具有高效的ROS调控、较高的叶绿素含量、增强的光系统II效率以及独特的气孔性状，从而导致较高的相对含水量。种质特异性的DNA甲基化组和转录组独特地调控了CB1幼苗在胁迫恢复期间叶绿素生物合成、光系统、捕光复合体和ROS清除基因的表达。有趣的是，CB1中较高的D1蛋白周转促进了PSII的损伤修复以实现高效光合作用。此外，气孔发育的关键转录因子和光合基因的表达在CB1胁迫恢复期间上调。值得注意的是，在低温胁迫和恢复期间，CB1植株中GLK1的表达较高且GLK1靶标富集。综上所述，我们的结果表明，GLK1和WRKY40负调控ABI5的抑制作用，以实现有效的光合恢复，从而增强CB1水稻的耐冷性。

papers.title: Two copy-number forms of the Kala4/OsB2 upstream duplication in purple rice revealed by a telomere-to-telomere genome of landrace ZN65
papers.translated_title: 紫米中Kala4/OsB2上游重复的两种拷贝数形式，由地方品种ZN65的端粒到端粒基因组揭示
papers.author: Zhao, F.
papers.summary: Background: Black and purple pericarp in rice requires activation of the regulator Kala4/OsB2. The canonical black-rice allele is a promoter rearrangement that was described from DNA gel blots and amplified fragments, and its sequence is unavailable. Whether pigmented landraces carry one upstream structure or several is therefore unknown. We examined this region in the purple-pericarp landrace Mojiang ZN65 and its distribution in sequenced rice germplasm. Results: We assembled a gap-free telomere-to-telomere genome of ZN65 (395.1 Mb; all 24 telomeres). Upstream of Kala4/OsB2, a 5.87-kb segment (block A) and a 6.0-kb segment that contains the first two annotated exons of OsB2 were each present in three non-tandem copies. The arrangement was reproduced by an independent HiFi-only assembly and was spanned by three Nanopore reads. Among 2,913 accessions of the 3,000 Rice Genomes panel, read depth detected block A gain in 29 (1.0%), 17 at three or more copies and 12 at two. All 29 carried read pairs joining block A to the OsB2 5' segment, and none of 58 matched controls did. A junction specific to the third copy was found in 16 of these 17 and in 2 of these 12. Among 2,055 accessions with recorded seed-coat colour, 18 of 19 purple accessions carried the gain, and purple was recorded for 9 of 13 and 9 of 11 carriers of the two classes. Among 210 NCBI assemblies and 264 Genome Warehouse materials, five carried the junctions with two copies of block A, and one, the Chinese accession Momi, carried three copies, which its Nanopore reads confirmed. An elevated OsKala3 promoter-repeat depth ratio was found in 21 of 29 carriers, and four purple carriers lacked it. Conclusions: ZN65 provides a gap-free, read-supported sequence of a Kala4/OsB2 upstream duplication that occurs in at least two copy-number forms in purple rice. Its gene-proximal part has the same kinds of elements in the same order as the published description of the canonical black-rice allele, although the segment lengths differ. Both forms were found in purple accessions, and the additional copy showed no relation to recorded colour. Its effect on OsB2 expression remains untested.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：水稻黑色和紫色果皮需要调控因子Kala4/OsB2的激活。典型的黑米等位基因是一个启动子重排，此前通过DNA印迹和扩增片段进行了描述，其序列尚不可得。因此，色素地方品种携带一种还是多种上游结构尚不清楚。我们检测了紫果皮地方品种墨江紫糯65（Mojiang ZN65）中该区域及其在已测序水稻种质中的分布。结果：我们组装了ZN65的无缺口端粒到端粒基因组（395.1 Mb；全部24个端粒）。在Kala4/OsB2上游，一个5.87 kb片段（A块）和一个6.0 kb片段（包含OsB2前两个注释外显子）各以三个非串联拷贝存在。该排列通过独立的仅HiFi组装得以重现，并由三条Nanopore读长跨越。在3,000份水稻基因组计划的2,913份材料中，读长深度检测到29份（1.0%）存在A块增加，其中17份为三个或更多拷贝，12份为两个拷贝。全部29份均携带连接A块与OsB2 5'片段的读长对，而58份匹配对照中无一携带。一个第三拷贝特异的连接在17份中的16份和12份中的2份中被发现。在2,055份有种皮颜色记录的材料中，19份紫色材料中有18份携带该增加，两类携带者中分别有13份中的9份和11份中的9份记录为紫色。在210个NCBI组装和264份基因组仓库材料中，5份携带两个A块拷贝的连接，1份中国材料Momi携带三个拷贝，其Nanopore读长予以确认。29份携带者中有21份发现OsKala3启动子重复深度比升高，4份紫色携带者缺乏该特征。结论：ZN65提供了一个无缺口、有读长支持的Kala4/OsB2上游重复序列，该重复在紫米中至少以两种拷贝数形式存在。其基因近端部分与已发表的黑米典型等位基因描述具有相同种类和顺序的元件，尽管片段长度不同。两种形式均在紫色材料中发现，且额外拷贝与记录的颜色无关。其对OsB2表达的影响尚未检测。

papers.title: A sunflower FLS2 guides reconstruction of immune-evasive Xanthomonas flg22 recognition across divergent FLS2 backgrounds
papers.translated_title: 向日葵FLS2指导跨 divergent FLS2 背景重建免疫逃逸型 Xanthomonas flg22 识别
papers.author: Zhong, L.
papers.summary: Immune-evasive Xanthomonas flg22 epitopes pose a challenge to FLS2-mediated immune surveillance. A further challenge is to reconstruct their recognition across divergent FLS2 backgrounds with a limited number of amino-acid substitutions. AlphaFold 3 (AF3) screening of 256 natural FLS2 homologues identified sunflower HaFLS2-1, responsive to flg22Xcc and flg22Xoo in transient ROS assays. We validated flg22Xcc recognition by in planta ligand-association assays and immune responses in stable Arabidopsis lines. Guided by HaFLS2-1 ligand-proximal residues, iterative AF3 searches generated PsFLS2 (Salicaceae) and TjFLS2 (Apocynaceae) variants recognising flg22Xcc with ten or fewer substitutions. Single-residue reversions revealed functional contributions from over half of recurrent substitutions in both backgrounds. RcFLS2 (Rosaceae) variants acquired flg22Xcc responsiveness. In tomato SlFLS2 (Solanaceae), three substitutions significantly enhanced flg22Xcc responses, while all three variants carrying two to four substitutions acquired flg22Xoo responsiveness. These findings demonstrate the utility of AF3-guided natural-receptor discovery and iterative engineering for reconstructing and expanding flg22 recognition.
papers.translated_summary: 免疫逃逸型Xanthomonas flg22表位对FLS2介导的免疫监视构成挑战。另一项挑战是在有限数量的氨基酸替换下，跨不同FLS2背景重建其识别能力。AlphaFold 3（AF3）对256个天然FLS2同源物的筛选鉴定出向日葵HaFLS2-1，其在瞬时ROS实验中响应flg22Xcc和flg22Xoo。我们通过植物体内配体结合实验和稳定拟南芥株系中的免疫反应验证了flg22Xcc的识别。以HaFLS2-1配体近端残基为指导，迭代AF3搜索生成了PsFLS2（Salicaceae）和TjFLS2（Apocynaceae）变体，其以十个或更少替换识别flg22Xcc。单残基回复揭示了两个背景中超过半数重复替换的功能贡献。RcFLS2（Rosaceae）变体获得了flg22Xcc响应性。在番茄SlFLS2（Solanaceae）中，三个替换显著增强了flg22Xcc响应，而所有携带两到四个替换的三个变体均获得了flg22Xoo响应性。这些发现证明了AF3指导的天然受体发现和迭代工程在重建和扩展flg22识别方面的效用。

papers.title: Acetate promotes nutritional adaptation in Escherichia coli
papers.translated_title: 醋酸盐促进大肠杆菌的营养适应
papers.author: Devlin, L.
papers.summary: Escherichia coli often releases acetate in its environment where it can accumulate to concentrations high enough to inhibit the bacterium's own growth. Here, we demonstrate that acetate promotes E. coli adaptation to nutrient changes by accelerating growth resumption, with as little as 250 M acetate being sufficient to shorten the lag phase by several hours. Acetate was found to be consumed via acetyl-CoA synthetase very early after the nutrient change. Transcriptomics, metabolomics and 13C-isotope labeling experiments show that acetate replenishes metabolic pools in the tricarboxylic acid cycle and upper glycolysis. Single-cell analyses reveal that acetate increases the adaptation speed of individual cells switching to the new nutrient. We conclude that the reuse of excreted acetate by E. coli facilitates nutritional adaptation by transiently replenishing central metabolite pools. This work identifies an unexpected role of acetate in the nutritional adaptation of E. coli, providing new insights into the physiological relevance of overflow metabolism.
papers.translated_summary: 大肠杆菌常在其环境中释放乙酸盐，乙酸盐可在环境中积累至足以抑制该细菌自身生长的浓度。在此，我们证明乙酸盐通过加速生长恢复来促进大肠杆菌对营养变化的适应，仅250 M的乙酸盐就足以将延滞期缩短数小时。研究发现，在营养变化后极早期，乙酸盐即通过乙酰辅酶A合成酶被消耗。转录组学、代谢组学和13C同位素标记实验表明，乙酸盐补充了三羧酸循环和上游糖酵解中的代谢池。单细胞分析揭示，乙酸盐提高了单个细胞转向新营养物时的适应速度。我们得出结论：大肠杆菌对排泄的乙酸盐的再利用通过瞬时补充中心代谢物池来促进营养适应。这项工作揭示了乙酸盐在大肠杆菌营养适应中的意外作用，为溢流代谢的生理相关性提供了新见解。

papers.title: Cohort Versus Nested Case-Control Designs for Predicting Early-Onset Gastrointestinal Cancer Using Electronic Health Records
papers.translated_title: 队列与巢式病例对照设计在利用电子健康记录预测早发性胃肠道癌症中的比较
papers.author: Fan, R.
papers.summary: Purpose: To determine how cohort and case-control study designs affect the discrimination, calibration, and feature rankings of EHR-based models for predicting early-onset gastrointestinal cancer. Methods: Using EHR data from an integrated health system, we developed models to predict EOGIC within 2 years after an outpatient visit among adults age 18-49 years at the time of the visit. We compared two cohort and five case-control designs. Models included L1-regularized logistic regression (LASSO), XGBoost, and multilayer perceptrons (MLP). Models were trained with nested five-fold cross-validation. We assessed model discrimination using area under the precision recall curve (AUPRC), area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), calibration before and after isotonic recalibration, and similarity of feature rankings across study designs and predictive models. Results: AUROC does not depend on outcome prevalence, it is suitable for comparing discrimination across study designs with different outcome prevalences; however, it was less sensitive to variation in model performance in this rare-outcome setting. AUPRC estimated in case-enriched samples did not generalize to the incidence-representative population in the intended deployment setting. Raw predicted probabilities substantially overestimated observed risks under both study designs. Isotonic recalibration improved calibration, although residual miscalibration remained. Cohort-based feature rankings were more consistent across algorithms, whereas case-control-based rankings depended more strongly on algorithms. Conclusion: Study design substantially affects the discrimination, calibration, and feature-ranking patterns of EHR-based EOGIC prediction models. Cohort designs are generally better suited to EHR-based models for early detection because they preserve the outcome incidence and temporal relationship between the predictors and the outcome. When case-control designs are used for model development, models should be evaluated and recalibrated in an incidence-representative cohort that reflects the intended clinical setting.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：确定队列和病例对照研究设计如何影响基于电子健康记录的模型在预测早发性胃肠道癌症时的区分度、校准度和特征排序。方法：使用来自 integrated health system 的电子健康记录数据，我们开发了模型，用于预测18-49岁成年人在门诊就诊后2年内发生EOGIC的风险。我们比较了两种队列设计和五种病例对照设计。模型包括L1正则化逻辑回归（LASSO）、XGBoost和多层感知机（MLP）。模型采用嵌套五折交叉验证进行训练。我们使用精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）、受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）、等渗重校准前后的校准度，以及不同研究设计和预测模型之间特征排序的相似性来评估模型区分度。结果：AUROC不依赖于结局患病率，因此适用于比较不同结局患病率研究设计之间的区分度；然而，在这种罕见结局情境下，它对模型性能变化较不敏感。在病例富集样本中估计的AUPRC不能推广到预期部署环境中具有发病率代表性的人群。在两种研究设计下，原始预测概率均大幅高估了观察到的风险。等渗重校准改善了校准度，但仍存在残余校准不良。基于队列的特征排序在不同算法之间更为一致，而基于病例对照的排序则更强烈地依赖于算法。结论：研究设计显著影响基于电子健康记录的EOGIC预测模型的区分度、校准度和特征排序模式。队列设计通常更适合用于早期检测的基于电子健康记录的模型，因为它们保留了结局发病率以及预测变量与结局之间的时间关系。当使用病例对照设计进行模型开发时，应在反映预期临床环境的具有发病率代表性的队列中对模型进行评估和重校准。

papers.title: Human infection incidence for West Nile virus and Usutu virus in the Netherlands: evidence from a longitudinal nationwide cohort, 2020-2023
papers.translated_title: 荷兰西尼罗病毒和乌苏图病毒感染的人间发病率：来自2020-2023年全国纵向队列的证据
papers.author: Grobben, M.
papers.summary: Background Ecological surveillance indicates (regional) establishment of West Nile virus (WNV) and Usutu virus (USUV) in the Netherlands. However, the incidence of human infections remains unknown. We investigated the incidence of WNV and USUV infections in the Netherlands in 2020-2023. Methods We applied a two-tiered serology approach based on protein micro-array and virus neutralization on the participants of the PICO cohort. Which is a well-described, longitudinal, nationwide population-based cohort. IgG data were used to estimate overall seroprevalence and infection incidence as the primary outcome, and to study antibody longevity. Study set-up enabled tracking of the period of seroconversion and linking of self-reported travel history. The analyses took account of the survey design and weights were incorporated to match the Dutch population distribution following census data. Findings Among 4281 participants, we identified 113 probable WNV and/or USUV cases, including 55 seroconversions. Thirty-six cases were confirmed by antibody neutralization, of which 12 seroconverted. Six confirmed seroconverters were identified as autochthonous infections. The overall weighted seroprevalence was estimated at 0.54% (0.21-0.87%) for WNV and 0.25% (0.09-0.40%) for USUV. The weighted cumulative incidence in 2020-2023 for autochthonous WNV and USUV infection was estimated as respectively 0.06% (95% CI 0-0.12%) and 0.04% (95% CI 0-0.09%). Interpretation The estimated infection incidence and seroprevalence of WNV and USUV suggest a substantial underdiagnosis of clinical cases in the Netherlands in 2020-2023. These observations highlight the need for increased awareness among physicians to identify cases and the need for continued paired syndromic-laboratory surveillance for these viruses. Funding This study was funded by the ministry of Health, Welfare and Sports, the Netherlands.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 生态监测表明，西尼罗病毒（WNV）和乌苏图病毒（USUV）已在荷兰（区域）建立。然而，人类感染的发病率仍然未知。我们调查了2020-2023年荷兰WNV和USUV感染的发病率。方法 我们对PICO队列参与者应用了基于蛋白质微阵列和病毒中和的两级血清学方法。PICO队列是一个描述完善的、纵向的、全国性人群队列。IgG数据用于估计总体血清阳性率和感染发病率作为主要结局，并用于研究抗体持久性。研究设置使得能够追踪血清阳转时期并关联自我报告的旅行史。分析考虑了调查设计，并纳入权重以匹配根据人口普查数据的荷兰人口分布。结果 在4281名参与者中，我们识别了113例可能WNV和/或USUV病例，包括55例血清阳转。36例通过抗体中和确认，其中12例血清阳转。6例确认的血清阳转者被鉴定为本地感染。总体加权血清阳性率估计为WNV 0.54%（0.21-0.87%）和USUV 0.25%（0.09-0.40%）。2020-2023年本地WNV和USUV感染的加权累积发病率估计分别为0.06%（95% CI 0-0.12%）和0.04%（95% CI 0-0.09%）。解释 WNV和USUV的估计感染发病率和血清阳性率表明，2020-2023年荷兰临床病例存在大量诊断不足。这些观察结果强调需要提高医生识别病例的意识，并需要对这些病毒继续进行配对症状-实验室监测。资助 本研究由荷兰卫生、福利和体育部资助。

papers.title: Fine-tuned encoders, generative large language models and typed decisions for classifying findings in chest CT reports: paired English-Japanese internal testing and external testing on naturally written Japanese reports
papers.translated_title: 微调编码器、生成式大语言模型与类型化决策用于胸部CT报告发现分类：配对英日内部测试及自然书写日语报告的外部测试
papers.author: fukui, y.
papers.summary: PurposeTo compare fine-tuned encoders, generative large language models (LLMs) and typed decisions (per-finding yes/no questions answered with a probability) for classifying 18 findings in chest CT reports, and to identify when typed decisions help. MethodsThis retrospective study used public data. The internal test set comprised 150 CT-RATE reports with paired Japanese translations at three quality levels; the external test set, 243 naturally written Japanese reports with human annotations (RR-Findings). We compared ModernBERT encoders fine-tuned on 20,444 reports, generative LLMs (gpt-6-luna, Qwen3.8-27B, MedGemma), and typed decisions with Jev, the Decisions API and Qwen. Thresholds fixed on 450 development reports were applied unchanged externally. The primary metric was micro-F1; case-level paired bootstrap 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated for 11 internal comparisons. ResultsEncoders were best internally (English 0.9853; radiologist-checked Japanese 0.9576) and exceeded Jev (differences 0.0367, 95% CI 0.0258-0.0484; 0.0336, 0.0215-0.0464). Externally, Jev (0.8844) lay within the encoder seed range (0.8656-0.9144), exceeded the three generative conditions tested externally (best 0.8564) and the Decisions API (0.8177), and had the smallest internal-to-external decrease (-0.0396). An encoder trained on 2,044 reports reached 0.8226 externally. Typed-versus-generated differences changed direction across models and test sets. At a fixed threshold of 0.5, Jev fell to 0.7753 externally. ConclusionFine-tuned encoders performed best with ample in-distribution labels. Although threshold-dependent, Jev, with thresholds fitted on only 450 labeled reports, fell within the encoder seed range externally and exceeded the generative LLMs and an encoder trained on 2,044 reports, making it an option when labels are scarce.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：比较微调编码器、生成式大语言模型（LLMs）和类型化决策（针对每项发现的 yes/no 问题以概率作答）在胸部 CT 报告中对 18 项发现进行分类的表现，并确定类型化决策在何种情况下有帮助。方法：本回顾性研究使用公开数据。内部测试集包含 150 份 CT-RATE 报告，配有三种质量水平的日文翻译；外部测试集包含 243 份自然书写的日文报告，带有人工标注（RR-Findings）。我们比较了在 20,444 份报告上微调的 ModernBERT 编码器、生成式 LLMs（gpt-6-luna、Qwen3.8-27B、MedGemma）以及使用 Jev、Decisions API 和 Qwen 的类型化决策。在 450 份开发报告上固定的阈值在外部未作改动地应用。主要指标为 micro-F1；针对 11 项内部比较计算了病例级配对 bootstrap 95% 置信区间（CIs）。结果：编码器在内部表现最佳（英文 0.9853；经放射科医生核对的日文 0.9576），并超过 Jev（差异 0.0367，95% CI 0.0258-0.0484；0.0336，0.0215-0.0464）。在外部，Jev（0.8844）位于编码器种子范围内（0.8656-0.9144），超过在外部测试的三种生成式条件（最佳 0.8564）和 Decisions API（0.8177），且内部到外部的下降最小（-0.0396）。在 2,044 份报告上训练的编码器在外部达到 0.8226。类型化与生成式之间的差异在不同模型和测试集间方向发生变化。在固定阈值 0.5 下，Jev 在外部降至 0.7753。结论：在分布内标签充足时，微调编码器表现最佳。尽管依赖阈值，Jev 仅在 450 份标注报告上拟合阈值，在外部仍位于编码器种子范围内，并超过生成式 LLMs 和在 2,044 份报告上训练的编码器，使其在标签稀缺时成为一种选择。

papers.title: A proteomic signature for prognostic stratification in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
papers.translated_title: 肌萎缩侧索硬化预后分层的蛋白质组学特征
papers.author: Lester, D. G.
papers.summary: Biochemical predictors of survival are essential to control heterogeneity and identify associations of disease progression in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). We performed high-depth Proximity Extension Assay proteomics using longitudinal serum (n=851) and CSF (n=244) samples from 426 people with ALS, replicated in a further 460 patients. Cox regression identified five CSF proteins, including tropomyosin 3 (TPM3), and 57 serum proteins, including neurofilament light chain (NEFL) and peripherin, associated with survival. Lasso regression identified an eight-protein serum panel, including NEFL, peripherin, EDA2R and CALCA -- reflecting both disease extent and progression rate -- that improved survival prediction beyond clinical parameters and NEFL: external validation c-statistic 0.78 versus 0.74 ({Delta} 95% CI 0.00-0.08), p=0.066; 1-year AUC 0.89 versus 0.84 (0.00-0.11), p=0.047. Joint modelling identified survival-associated trajectories of serum EDA2R and CALCA, highlighting their potential to measure disease progression. These findings identify diverse serum proteins that enhance survival stratification and are associated with disease progression in ALS.
papers.translated_summary: 生化预测因子对于控制肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的异质性并识别疾病进展相关关联至关重要。我们利用来自426名ALS患者的纵向血清（n=851）和脑脊液（n=244）样本进行了高深度邻近延伸分析蛋白质组学检测，并在另外460名患者中进行了重复验证。Cox回归识别出五种脑脊液蛋白（包括原肌球蛋白3，TPM3）和57种血清蛋白（包括神经丝轻链，NEFL和周边蛋白）与生存相关。Lasso回归识别出一个八蛋白血清组合，包括NEFL、周边蛋白、EDA2R和CALCA——反映疾病范围和进展速率——该组合在临床参数和NEFL之外改善了生存预测：外部验证c统计量为0.78对0.74（Δ 95% CI 0.00-0.08），p=0.066；1年AUC为0.89对0.84（0.00-0.11），p=0.047。联合模型识别出与生存相关的血清EDA2R和CALCA轨迹，突显其测量疾病进展的潜力。这些发现识别出多种血清蛋白，可增强生存分层并与ALS疾病进展相关。

papers.title: Sequential rTMS-tACS Neuromodulation Is Associated with Increased Resting-State Theta Activity in Fibromyalgia: A Randomized Controlled Pilot Study
papers.translated_title: 序贯rTMS-tACS神经调控与纤维肌痛患者静息态θ活动增加相关：一项随机对照预试验
papers.author: Buran, O.
papers.summary: BackgroundSequential application of repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) and transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) may induce neurophysiological changes within sensorimotor and pain-related networks. However, the resting-state EEG effects of this combined approach in fibromyalgia remain unknown. MethodsIn this exploratory randomized controlled pilot study, 10 adults with fibromyalgia were assigned to active stimulation (n = 5) or a no-stimulation control group (n = 5). Active participants received one or two sessions of 10-Hz rTMS over the left primary motor cortex (1,000 pulses/session), followed by 10 daily sessions of bilateral 10-Hz tACS (1 mA, 20 min). Six-minute eyes-closed resting-state EEG recordings were obtained before and after the intervention or an equivalent control interval. Power spectral density was quantified in the delta, theta, alpha, and beta bands and analyzed using mixed repeated-measures ANOVAs across central-centroparietal and posterior regions of interest. ResultsTheta power increased significantly in the active group but not in controls, yielding significant Time x Group (F(1,8)=8.70, p=.018, p{superscript 2}=.521) and Time x ROI x Group (F(1,8)=5.53, p=.047, p{superscript 2}=.409) interactions. Follow-up analyses showed increased theta power in both central-centroparietal (p=.004) and posterior (p=.012) regions, with a larger increase observed posteriorly. No significant interaction effects were found for delta, alpha, or beta power. ConclusionsSequential motor-cortex rTMS followed by repeated bilateral 10-Hz tACS was associated with increased resting-state theta activity in fibromyalgia. Given the small sample size, post hoc ROI selection, lack of sham stimulation, and absence of component-specific control conditions, these findings should be considered hypothesis-generating and require replication in adequately powered sham-controlled studies.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）与经颅交流电刺激（tACS）的序贯应用可能在感觉运动和疼痛相关网络内诱导神经生理学改变。然而，该联合方法在纤维肌痛中的静息态脑电效应尚不清楚。方法：在这项探索性随机对照初步研究中，10名纤维肌痛成人被分配至主动刺激组（n=5）或无刺激对照组（n=5）。主动组参与者接受一次或两次左侧初级运动皮层10 Hz rTMS（每次1000个脉冲），随后接受10次每日双侧10 Hz tACS（1 mA，20分钟）。在干预前及干预后或等效对照间隔后获取6分钟闭眼静息态脑电记录。对delta、theta、alpha和beta频段的功率谱密度进行量化，并使用混合重复测量方差分析在中央-中央顶叶和后部感兴趣区进行分析。结果：主动组theta功率显著增加，而对照组未增加，产生显著的时间×组别（F(1,8)=8.70，p=.018，p{superscript 2}=.521）和时间×感兴趣区×组别（F(1,8)=5.53，p=.047，p{superscript 2}=.409）交互作用。随访分析显示中央-中央顶叶（p=.004）和后部（p=.012）区域的theta功率均增加，后部增加幅度更大。delta、alpha或beta功率未发现显著交互效应。结论：序贯运动皮层rTMS后接重复双侧10 Hz tACS与纤维肌痛患者静息态theta活动增加相关。鉴于样本量小、感兴趣区为事后选择、缺乏假刺激以及缺乏组分特异性对照条件，这些发现应被视为假设生成性，需要在有足够效能的假刺激对照研究中重复验证。

papers.title: A distributed, privacy-preserving platform for linkage of epidemiological data with pathogen genome sequences
papers.translated_title: 一个分布式、隐私保护的平台，用于流行病学数据与病原体基因组序列的关联
papers.author: Langevin, J.
papers.summary: Efficient and secure integration of epidemiological data with pathogen genome sequence data is essential for identifying genetic clusters, monitoring emerging mutations and targeting public health responses. However, this information is often collected across different organisations: epidemiological data is collected by public health units while genome sequence data is collected by diagnostic laboratories. Linking these sources often requires manual or semi-manual approaches, leading to unnecessary delays in identifying emerging outbreaks. To address this, we developed a proof-of-concept privacy-preserving distributed platform, SecureEpiLink, for automatic linkage of pathogen genome sequences and notification data across public health and diagnostic laboratories. SecureEpiLink uses cryptographic hashing to establish linkage, without exposing personal identifying information. This ensures that the resulting linked data can be used to identify the emergence of genetic clusters without identification of individuals comprising each cluster, with the original identifiable data remaining stored at source units. We benchmarked SecureEpiLink against manual linkage and another linkage service using HIV and HCV datasets from New South Wales, Australia. SecureEpiLink performed similarly to manual linkage and outperformed previously used linkage algorithms, with all errors attributable to data entry errors in the underlying dataset. Lastly, we demonstrate how SecureEpiLink can be integrated with automated genomic epidemiology pipelines. SecureEpiLink is available from https://github.com/jolenefarrell/SecureEpiLink.
papers.translated_summary: 高效且安全地整合流行病学数据与病原体基因组序列数据，对于识别遗传簇、监测新发突变以及指导公共卫生应对至关重要。然而，这些信息通常由不同机构收集：流行病学数据由公共卫生单位收集，而基因组序列数据由诊断实验室收集。将这些来源关联起来往往需要手动或半手动方法，导致在识别新发疫情时出现不必要的延误。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一个概念验证性的隐私保护分布式平台SecureEpiLink，用于跨公共卫生和诊断实验室自动关联病原体基因组序列与通报数据。SecureEpiLink使用密码学哈希来建立关联，而不暴露个人身份信息。这确保了所得关联数据可用于识别遗传簇的出现，而无需识别构成每个簇的个体，原始可识别数据仍存储在来源单位。我们使用来自澳大利亚新南威尔士州的HIV和HCV数据集，将SecureEpiLink与手动关联以及另一种关联服务进行了基准测试。SecureEpiLink的表现与手动关联相似，并优于先前使用的关联算法，所有错误均可归因于底层数据集中的数据录入错误。最后，我们展示了SecureEpiLink如何与自动化基因组流行病学流程集成。SecureEpiLink可从https://github.com/jolenefarrell/SecureEpiLink获取。

papers.title: Adjunctive Accelerated Theta-Burst Stimulation for Inpatient Treatment-Resistant Depression: A Randomized Clinical Trial
papers.translated_title: 辅助加速θ爆发刺激治疗住院难治性抑郁症：一项随机临床试验
papers.author: Mueller, C.
papers.summary: Importance: Standard repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation protocols are difficult to integrate into inpatient psychiatric care because they require daily treatment over several weeks. Accelerated intermittent theta-burst stimulation (iTBS) may offer a feasible augmentation strategy for hospitalized patients with treatment-resistant depression (TRD). Objective: To determine whether connectivity-guided accelerated iTBS improves depressive symptoms beyond routine multimodal inpatient care in hospitalized patients with TRD. Design, Setting, and Participants: This randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled clinical trial was conducted in the inpatient unit of the Department of Psychiatry, University of Oldenburg, Karl-Jaspers-Klinik, Bad Zwischenahn, Germany. Patients aged 18 to 65 years with unipolar TRD were recruited between May 2021 and August 2024. Interventions: Participants received active or sham iTBS targeting an individualized left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex site showing strongest functional anticorrelation with the subgenual anterior cingulate cortex using resting-state functional MRI. Treatment was delivered as 3 daily sessions over 10 weekdays (30 sessions; 54 000 pulses total) as augmentation to routine multimodal inpatient care. Main Outcomes and Measures: Primary and secondary outcomes were changes in Montgomery-Asberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) scores assessed weekly and Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II) scores assessed daily during the 2-week stimulation phase. Exploratory outcomes included response and remission rates. Results: Of 57 randomized participants, 51 completed treatment (active, n=27; sham, n=24). The cohort exhibited moderate-to-severe treatment resistance (mean Maudsley Staging Method score, 10.9) and psychiatric comorbidity in 82% of participants. Active iTBS was associated with steeper MADRS improvement than sham (-3.54 points/week; 95% CI, -5.53 to -1.55; false discovery rate-adjusted P<.001), corresponding to model-estimated reductions of 12.06 versus 4.98 points (Cohen d=-0.89). BDI-II trajectories similarly favored active treatment, although with a smaller effect size (-0.23 points/day; 95% CI, -0.41 to -0.05; false discovery rate-adjusted P=.02; Cohen d=0.22). MADRS response rates were higher with active iTBS (42.3% vs 13.0%), whereas remission rates were numerically but not significantly greater (26.9% vs 12.5%). No serious adverse events occurred. Conclusions and Relevance: Accelerated connectivity-guided iTBS produced significant add-on antidepressant effects during acute inpatient treatment of TRD. Larger multicenter trials are needed to establish durability and optimize clinical implementation. Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT04832750.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性：标准重复经颅磁刺激方案难以整合到住院精神科诊疗中，因为这些方案需要在数周内每日进行治疗。加速间歇性θ爆发刺激（iTBS）可能为住院的难治性抑郁症（TRD）患者提供一种可行的增效策略。目的：确定连接引导的加速iTBS是否能在常规多模式住院治疗之外进一步改善住院TRD患者的抑郁症状。设计、设置和参与者：这项随机、双盲、假对照临床试验在德国巴德茨维申安大学奥尔登堡精神病学系卡尔-雅斯贝尔斯诊所的住院病房进行。2021年5月至2024年8月期间招募了年龄18至65岁的单相TRD患者。干预：参与者接受活性或假iTBS，靶向基于静息态功能MRI显示的与膝下前扣带回皮层功能负相关最强的个体化左侧背外侧前额叶皮层位点。治疗在10个工作日内每日进行3次（共30次；总计54 000个脉冲），作为常规多模式住院治疗的增效措施。主要结局和指标：主要和次要结局分别为2周刺激阶段内每周评估的蒙哥马利-阿斯伯格抑郁评定量表（MADRS）评分变化和每日评估的贝克抑郁量表-II（BDI-II）评分变化。探索性结局包括应答率和缓解率。结果：57名随机参与者中，51名完成治疗（活性组n=27；假组n=24）。该队列表现出中度至重度治疗抵抗（Maudsley分期方法平均评分10.9），82%的参与者存在精神科共病。活性iTBS与假刺激相比与更陡峭的MADRS改善相关（-3.54分/周；95% CI，-5.53至-1.55；错误发现率校正P<.001），对应模型估计的降低幅度为12.06分对4.98分（Cohen d=-0.89）。BDI-II轨迹同样有利于活性治疗，尽管效应量较小（-0.23分/天；95% CI，-0.41至-0.05；错误发现率校正P=.02；Cohen d=0.22）。活性iTBS的MADRS应答率更高（42.3%对13.0%），而缓解率在数值上更高但无统计学显著性（26.9%对12.5%）。未发生严重不良事件。结论与意义：加速连接引导的iTBS在TRD急性住院治疗期间产生了显著的附加抗抑郁效应。需要更大规模的多中心试验来确定持久性并优化临床实施。试验注册：ClinicalTrials.gov标识符：NCT04832750。

papers.title: Metabolome-wide analysis suggests antidepressant exposure counteracts risk of depression in fatty-acid pathways
papers.translated_title: 代谢组全分析表明抗抑郁药暴露在脂肪酸通路中抵消抑郁风险
papers.author: Tsai, S.
papers.summary: Antidepressants are widely prescribed, yet their biological mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Large-scale metabolomics and linked electronic health records provide a unique opportunity to characterise metabolic profiles associated with medication exposure. We investigated metabolic signatures of antidepressant exposure using 251 nuclear magnetic resonance biomarkers in UK Biobank (N = 222,911), with external validation in NESDA and ALSPAC (N = 6,082) and longitudinal analyses (n = 5,820, mean follow-up = 4.2 years). We identified 152 metabolites associated with current antidepressant use (PFDR < 0.05), characterised by elevated triglycerides and very-low-density lipoproteins. Current users also showed higher omega-3 fatty acid levels and lower omega-6-to-omega-3 ratios, both associated with lower depression risk. Metabolic profile scores significantly distinguished antidepressant users in both external cohorts (OR = 1.07-1.39, ROC AUC = 0.58-0.73). Longitudinal analyses identified nominal associations between antidepressant initiation and increases in nine lipid biomarkers (effect size = 0.144-0.229). These findings suggest metabolic signatures associated with antidepressant use may not be solely explained by underlying depression and are characterised by both potentially beneficial fatty acid alterations and adverse lipid profiles. Validation across independent cohorts and consistency with longitudinal findings strengthen our evidence, supporting insights into antidepressant mechanism and its relevance to cardiometabolic health.
papers.translated_summary: 抗抑郁药被广泛处方，但其生物学机制仍未被完全理解。大规模代谢组学与关联的电子健康记录为刻画与药物暴露相关的代谢特征提供了独特机会。我们利用英国生物银行（N = 222,911）中的251个核磁共振生物标志物研究了抗抑郁药暴露的代谢特征，并在NESDA和ALSPAC（N = 6,082）中进行外部验证，同时开展纵向分析（n = 5,820，平均随访 = 4.2年）。我们识别出152个与当前抗抑郁药使用相关的代谢物（PFDR < 0.05），其特征为甘油三酯和极低密度脂蛋白升高。当前使用者还表现出较高的omega-3脂肪酸水平和较低的omega-6与omega-3比值，二者均与较低的抑郁风险相关。代谢特征评分在两个外部队列中均能显著区分抗抑郁药使用者（OR = 1.07-1.39，ROC AUC = 0.58-0.73）。纵向分析发现抗抑郁药起始与九种脂质生物标志物升高之间存在名义关联（效应量 = 0.144-0.229）。这些发现表明，与抗抑郁药使用相关的代谢特征可能不能仅由潜在抑郁来解释，其特征为既有潜在有益的脂肪酸改变，又有不利的脂质谱。在独立队列中的验证以及与纵向发现的一致性增强了我们的证据，支持了对反抑郁药机制及其与心血管代谢健康相关性的见解。

papers.title: Mucin VNTR haplogroup associations with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis are not independent of rs35705950
papers.translated_title: 黏蛋白VNTR单倍群与特发性肺纤维化的关联并非独立于rs35705950
papers.author: Reynolds, C.
papers.summary: BackgroundThe MUC5B promoter variant (rs35705950) is the strongest common genetic risk factor for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). MUC5B and MUC5AC contain variable number tandem repeat (VNTR) regions. Long-read sequencing resolves MUC5AC into three SNP-tagged haplogroups (H1, H2, H3) differing in repeat length, and MUC5B into two (H1, H2) differing in lineage but not length. The tags correlate with rs35705950, so whether a haplogroup effect is distinguishable from the promoter variant is unclear. MethodsWe assigned MUC5AC and MUC5B haplogroups from imputed chromosome 11 array data in 771 European-ancestry IPF Job Exposures Study participants (385 cases, 386 controls). Logistic regression adjusted for age, smoking, principal components and centre, with and without rs35705950. The same models were fitted in TOPMed (1,961 cases, 3,816 controls). ResultsMUC5AC H3 and MUC5B H1 were each associated with IPF (H3 OR 1.63, 95% CI 1.26-2.09, p=1.8x10-4; MUC5B H1 OR 0.71, 0.52-0.98, p=0.038). Both attenuated on adjustment for rs35705950 (H3 OR 1.10, 0.83-1.45, p=0.52; MUC5B H1 OR 0.82, 0.58-1.15, p=0.25). A MUC5AC H2 association persisted after adjustment (OR 0.69, 0.51-0.94, p=0.017). In TOPMed the H3 findings replicated (unadjusted OR 1.62, 1.47-1.78, p<10-15; adjusted 0.94, 0.84-1.05, p=0.26), but the rs35705950-adjusted H2 association did not: the estimate was null overall (OR 0.99, 0.88-1.11, p=0.87) and in men and women separately (1.00, 0.87-1.16; 0.97, 0.79-1.19). The MUC5B tag failed quality control in TOPMed. ConclusionsThe MUC5AC H3 and MUC5B H1 associations are not independent of rs35705950. The MUC5AC H2 association seen here did not replicate. VNTR haplogroup does not appear to contribute to IPF risk independently of rs35705950.

papers.title: Anatomical and spectral foundation of skin pigmentation bias in optical oximetry
papers.translated_title: 光学血氧测量中皮肤色素沉着偏差的解剖学与光谱学基础
papers.author: Wachter, F.
papers.summary: IMPORTANCE Monitoring hemoglobin oxygen saturation is a cornerstone of patient care across a wide range of clinical settings, with pulse oximetry remaining one of the most widely used technologies. Recent studies have identified skin pigmentation-related inaccuracies in these measurements; however, the biological and optical mechanisms underlying these limitations remain incompletely understood. OBJECTIVE To investigate the tissue compartments and wavelengths that drive skin pigmentation-related bias in oximetry using depth-resolved optoacoustic (OA) imaging. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS Prospective observational imaging study of n=46 healthy volunteers representing all 6 Fitzpatrick skin types (FST). EXPOSURES OA imaging of the tibialis anterior region during physiological oxygenation challenges induced by vascular occlusion, reperfusion, and exercise. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES A total of 3016 spatially resolved scans were obtained. Tissue compartments were segmented using a pretrained neural network. OA spectra, oxygen saturation estimates, responses to physiological interventions, and associations with skin pigmentation were evaluated across 41 wavelengths from 700 to 1100 nm. RESULTS Skin OA spectra closely mirrored the optical absorption characteristics of melanin, and OA signal intensities were strongly associated with FST, demonstrating a substantial influence of pigmentation on superficial oximetry measurements. Epidermal oxygen saturation estimates exhibited minimal changes during physiological interventions, especially in darkly pigmented skin. Skin signals showed pronounced associations with melanin-sensitive wavelengths, enabling FST classification based on optoacoustic skin signals. Pigmentation-related bias was greatest at shorter wavelengths and progressively decreased at longer wavelengths. In contrast, oxygenation measurements obtained from skeletal muscle were less affected by skin type and showed the strongest responses to vascular occlusion, reperfusion, and exercise. Depth-resolved OA imaging demonstrated that physiologically meaningful oxygenation information emerged only after propagation beyond the avascular epidermis into deeper vascularized tissue compartments. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE The combination of appropriate anatomical targeting, optimized wavelength selection, and correction for optical attenuation may represent a promising strategy for mitigating skin-pigmentation-related bias in oximetry.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性 监测血红蛋白氧饱和度是广泛临床环境中患者护理的基石，脉搏血氧测定法仍然是使用最广泛的技术之一。近期研究已发现这些测量中存在与皮肤色素沉着相关的不准确性；然而，这些局限性背后的生物学和光学机制仍未被完全理解。目的 利用深度分辨光声（OA）成像研究驱动血氧测定中皮肤色素沉着相关偏倚的组织 compartment 和波长。设计、设置和参与者 前瞻性观察性成像研究，纳入 n=46 名健康志愿者，代表所有 6 种 Fitzpatrick 皮肤类型（FST）。暴露 在血管闭塞、再灌注和运动诱导的生理氧合挑战期间，对胫骨前区域进行 OA 成像。主要结局和测量 共获得 3016 次空间分辨扫描。使用预训练神经网络对组织 compartment 进行分割。在 700 至 1100 nm 的 41 个波长范围内评估了 OA 光谱、氧饱和度估计、对生理干预的反应以及与皮肤色素沉着的关联。结果 皮肤 OA 光谱与黑色素的光学吸收特征高度一致，OA 信号强度与 FST 强相关，表明色素沉着对浅表血氧测定测量有显著影响。表皮氧饱和度估计在生理干预期间变化极小，尤其是在深色皮肤中。皮肤信号显示出与黑色素敏感波长的显著关联，使得能够基于光声皮肤信号进行 FST 分类。色素沉着相关偏倚在较短波长处最大，并在较长波长处逐渐减小。相比之下，从骨骼肌获得的氧合测量受皮肤类型影响较小，并显示出对血管闭塞、再灌注和运动的最强反应。深度分辨 OA 成像表明，具有生理意义的氧合信息仅在传播越过无血管表皮进入更深层血管化组织 compartment 后才出现。结论与意义 适当的解剖靶向、优化的波长选择以及对光学衰减的校正相结合，可能代表一种减轻血氧测定中皮肤色素沉着相关偏倚的有前景策略。
